description.narrative: To strengthen business networking and expand business opportunities for all value chain actors. To form one consolidated advocacy collation platform to push for favorable horticultural policies in the country. The project organized 2 heterogenous market convening where all the different major sub-groups where brought together to have cross breed of ideas and to collectively outline areas of synergies and cross business networking. At these heterogenous sessions producers got to know of huge market potential where trade associations import volumes of products into Ghana because limited production from producers. The heterogenous convening gave an opportunity for the various actors to network.
